newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-MORGAN WINS SENIOR EVENT BY ONE-SHOT OVER IRWIN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MORGAN WINS SENIOR EVENT BY ONE-SHOT OVER IRWIN.

text.p: Gil Morgan survived a bogey, double-bogey finish on the final two holes to claim a one-stroke victory over Hale Irwin on Sunday at the $1.2 million Ameritech Senior Open.

Morgan, 50, struggled to a two-over-par 74 to finish at six-under 210. He earned $180,000 for the victory, his third career Senior Tour win. He captured The Tradition, the first major of the year, last month.
Irwin entered the final round one shot behind Morgan, but also carded a 74, and missed a 25-foot birdie putt on the final hole which would have forced a playoff.
Irwin, who leads the Tour with four victories this season, picked up $105,600 for second place and remains atop the 1997 money list with $891,231.
With his victory, Morgan overtook Isao Aoki of Japan for second on the money list with $754,342.
Bob Eastwood, who walked away with his first Senior PGA Tour victory at last week's Bell Atlantic Classic, finished third at four-under after firing his second straight 71.
Mike Hill and Jerry McGee finished tied for fourth, two shot further adrift.
